items.name: use-reduced-motion
items.title: useReducedMotion
items.description: Tells components whether to reduce motion: the user's system setting, or your app's own through ReducedMotionProvider.

items.name: motion-tokens
items.title: Motion tokens
items.description: The durations and easing curves that Genframe's animated components share, as CSS variables.

items.name: estimate-cost
items.title: estimateCost
items.description: What a generation will cost, from a model's price and the run's settings: exact, rounded once, and in words.

items.name: generation-queue-reducer
items.title: generationQueueReducer
items.description: The generation queue's state as a pure reducer, which ignores events that arrive late, with selectors for a queued job's place in line and the time a job has left.

items.name: use-generation-queue
items.title: useGenerationQueue
items.description: Runs the generation queue's jobs on your driver, a few at a time: submit, cancel, retry and remove, and everything stops when it unmounts.

items.name: simulated-generator
items.title: createSimulatedGenerator
items.description: A pretend generator for demos and tests: a driver for useGenerationQueue that takes a while, reports its progress and sometimes fails, the same way every time.

items.name: use-thumbhash
items.title: useThumbHash
items.description: A ThumbHash as a placeholder: a tiny PNG data URL to show while the image loads.

items.name: compare-slider
items.title: CompareSlider
items.description: A before/after slider for two images or two videos: drag the divider, click where it should go or use the keys; two videos stay in step.

items.name: aspect-ratio-picker
items.title: AspectRatioPicker
items.description: Pick an aspect ratio from frames drawn in their shapes, with a preview frame that changes shape with the pick; disabled ratios say why.

items.name: model-picker
items.title: ModelPicker
items.description: A searchable list of models with their badges and prices, and what a run with the current settings would cost.

items.name: prompt-composer
items.title: PromptComposer
items.description: A prompt box built for generation: text that grows, @-mentions of reference images, preset chips, a character count, and a footer for your toolbar, the cost and submit.

items.name: generation-queue
items.title: GenerationQueue
items.description: Generation jobs as cards in a list: they slide into their new places, a live region announces each change of state, and focus moves on when a card goes.

items.name: generation-card
items.title: GenerationCard
items.description: One generation job: queued, running with its progress, its result revealed out of grain, failed or canceled, with the actions for its state.

items.name: denoise-reveal
items.title: DenoiseReveal
items.description: An image that sharpens out of grain and blur once it has loaded, the way a diffusion model makes one.

items.name: video-pool
items.title: createVideoPool
items.description: A fixed set of <video> elements that every card shares for its preview: it never makes more than its size, and takes back the least recently used one.

items.name: use-video-pool
items.title: useVideoPool
items.description: One video pool for everything inside VideoPoolProvider, and usePooledVideo, which borrows a video from it while a card should play.

items.name: masonry-layout
items.title: Masonry layout
items.description: Masonry math: the lanes at a width, each card placed by its aspect ratio, so a server and the browser place cards the same way at any width.

items.name: media-card
items.title: MediaCard
items.description: An image or video as a link or a button: its poster over a ThumbHash placeholder, and a video preview that plays from the shared pool while the pointer rests on it.

items.name: media-grid
items.title: MediaGrid
items.description: A virtualized masonry grid of media cards whose first screen is placed by CSS before any JavaScript runs, with hover-to-play previews from a shared video pool.

items.name: timecode
items.title: Timecode
items.description: Times and frames for video: m:ss and h:mm:ss, SMPTE timecode at any frame rate (23.976 and 29.97 included), frame-accurate seek times, and a time in words for screen readers.

items.name: use-scrubber
items.title: useScrubber
items.description: A scrub bar’s logic without its looks, for any player: the slider pattern with the time in words, pointer and frame-step seeking that never jumps back, buffered ranges, and useMediaElement to wire a <video>.

items.name: video-scrubber
items.title: VideoScrubber
items.description: A scrub bar for any video: the time played, buffered ranges, a hover preview with a thumbnail from a sprite sheet and its timecode, and frame-step keys when it has the frame rate.

items.name: camera-motion-picker
items.title: CameraMotionPicker
items.description: Pick a camera move from tiles that loop a clip of it on hover, keyboard focus or a tap, through the shared video pool; with reduced motion, posters and play buttons.
